items.title: FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
items.abstract: Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.

items.llm_tldr_cn: 安全强化学习常将安全与任务目标混在同一策略中导致更新冲突，而经典安全过滤器依赖解析安全函数与动力学模型，且短视于长时域回报，硬投影在无安全动作时也无定义。FAITH提出可行性感知的无模型框架，用前馈网络逼近最优状态-动作安全值并摊销最小干预过滤，任务策略通过过滤动力学优化回报。该方法在高维系统中实现了更可靠的安全约束满足。

items.title: A Unified Bellman Operator for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract: Reinforcement learning in safety-critical domains requires maximizing task performance while strictly adhering to safety constraints. Existing safe reinforcement learning paradigms typically force a trade-off: they either require a priori knowledge to provide strict safety guarantees (e.g., safety filters), or they enable joint learning but only satisfy safety constraints on average. In this work, we propose a novel Bellman operator that unifies performance and safety objectives into a joint value function. We show that temporal difference learning with the joint Bellman operator converges under a two-timescale stochastic approximation framework. On the fast timescale, the safety value of the learning joint policy is estimated, while the joint value is estimated on the slow timescale. Convergence is ensured by formulating the limiting dynamics as an occupation-averaged differential inclusion, and showing that it asymptotically converges to a set of limiting optimal safety-constrained task value functions. Theoretically, once converged, the resulting optimal policy maximizes task return while maintaining safety at all times. Empirical evaluations on continuous control tasks with neural approximations demonstrate stable convergence with near-zero safety violations at test time.

items.llm_tldr_en: Safe RL either needs prior knowledge for hard guarantees or only satisfies constraints on average. This paper proposes a unified Bellman operator combining performance and safety, proving TD convergence via two-timescale stochastic approximation, enabling strict safety with joint learning.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 安全关键领域的强化学习既要最大化任务性能，又必须严格满足安全约束，现有方法要么依赖先验知识提供硬性保证，要么只能满足平均意义下的安全。本文提出一种新的联合贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全目标统一到单一价值函数中，并在双时间尺度随机逼近框架下证明时序差分学习的收敛性。快时间尺度估计学习策略的安全价值，慢时间尺度更新联合价值，从而在无需先验的前提下兼顾严格安全与联合学习。该结果为安全强化学习提供了兼顾保证与可学习性的统一理论工具。
